evals.prompt: Prepare an animated Blender prop for Godot 4.6 as GLB with two named clips, a measured 1 m feature, offset pivot and documented collision method. Preserve source and verify in a disposable Godot scene when available.
evals.expected_output: A controlled GLB and calibration/import evidence covering transforms, materials, clips and collision; unavailable target clearly reported.
assertions: Known dimension, forward marker and pivot are checked after import.
Clip names/durations and representative motion are observed rather than inferred from counts.
Godot collision hint policy is explicit; UCX naming is not assumed to work.

evals.prompt: A Godot import has a 100x scale error, missing roughness and a convex doorway collision blocking the opening. No Godot editor is available for your correction pass.
evals.expected_output: Traces source/export/import settings, prepares bounded fixes and leaves target acceptance unperformed rather than reporting engine success.
assertions: Scale correction is traced through units/export/import instead of hidden ancestor scaling.
Material packing and proxy passage intent are addressed.
Blender reimport or output presence is not called a Godot pass.
